packages.vo: Before Chainsaw Man, before Jujutsu Kaisen, and before Kaiju Number 8, there was Black Torch. A manga where a teenage punk named Jiro takes a killing blow, and a monster cat named Rago fuses into the wound to save him, using a power system almost identical to the ones that made those three shows massive. It got cancelled after just five volumes — low sales, nobody watching. Now it's finally an anime, and the original creator is personally supervising every storyboard, calling this version "something even better." Now that you know Black Torch came first, does Chainsaw Man's power system still feel as original? Leave your take.
